blocking_findings.title: Missing or malformed timestamps satisfy the new binding check
blocking_findings.detail: Binding equality uses citation.get(key) == row.get(key), but existing _explain_archived_headline_context does not validate keyword timestamps. Removing timestamp from both the keyword_5 and matching past_1 citations yields None == None and exempts the mixed BTC/ETH precedent. Setting both timestamps to [] also exempts it. Both malformed payloads pass the real client normalizer and preserve the precedent, whereas the exact prechange guard rejects them. This contradicts the checkpoint's strict timestamp binding and missing/wrongly typed citation refusal contract.
blocking_findings.reproduction: Use existing cited fixture for past; remove timestamp from keyword_match document_id 5 and past citation, or set both to []. Current refused(raw,'BTC') is false and normal provider is fallback with the field preserved. Unchanged checks.evaluate rejects both payloads.
blocking_findings.impact_limit: This is a new malformed-input exemption at client classification, not proof of provenance or runtime trading fail-open. The unchanged evidence verifier remains fail-closed for these cases.
blocking_findings.required_next_proof: Require explicit presence and appropriate timestamp shape on both sides before applying the new exemption, with negatives for missing, null/non-string and mismatched types/values. No fix performed.

blocking_findings.title: Citation uniqueness is checked by type, not citation ID
blocking_findings.detail: The implementation requires one row with type past/future but never checks whether past_1/future_1 is duplicated elsewhere in evidence. Appending a copy of the bound past citation with the same id past_1 and type news leaves one past-kind row, so the new exemption still applies. The real normalizer accepts this duplicate-ID payload; the exact prechange guard rejects it and the unchanged evidence verifier rejects it. Existing duplicate test appends the same type and therefore misses this cross-type duplicate.
blocking_findings.reproduction: Use cited past fixture; append {**deepcopy(past_citation), 'type':'news'} retaining id past_1. Current guard returns false, client preserves the mixed-title past field, and evidence_all_true is false.
blocking_findings.impact_limit: No general foreign-text waiver or accepted end-to-end runtime execution was demonstrated. The gap is against the advertised unambiguous-citation/duplicate-refusal normalization contract.
blocking_findings.required_next_proof: Establish uniqueness of the selected citation ID across the full evidence collection before exemption and add cross-type duplicate-ID negative coverage. No fix performed.
